shellCommands.command: ls -la && git log --stat | head -30 && cat package.json 2>/dev/null; head -c 600 package-lock.json; node --version; npm --version

node -e '
const fs=require("fs");const p=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync("package.json"));
p.scripts={start:"node server.js",test:"vitest run",...p.scripts};
fs.writeFileSync("package.json",JSON.stringify(p,null,2)+"\n")' && printf 'data/\n' >> .gitignore && cat package.json .gitignore
export DATA_FILE=/tmp/e2e-books.json PORT=3456; rm -f $DATA_FILE
node server.js & PID=$!; sleep 0.5
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "add: %{http_code} -> %{redirect_url}\n" -d 'title=The+Hobbit&author=Tolkien&notes=Hello%0Aworld' localhost:3456/books
ID=$(node -e 'console.log(JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync(process.env.DATA_FILE))[0].id)')
kill $PID; wait $PID 2>/dev/null
node server.js & PID=$!; sleep 0.5
echo "after restart:"; curl -s localhost:3456/books/$ID | grep -E 'h2|by |share|notes"'
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "finish: %{http_code}\n" -d from=home localhost:3456/books/$ID/finish
curl -s localhost:3456/ | grep -A3 '<h2>Finished'
kill $PID; cat $DATA_FILE
